neighbours.label: advice verbs 'recommend', 'suggest', 'encourage' when the writer gives advice
fire: The staff were friendly and quick, and I would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting the coast.
If your tomatoes keep splitting, we recommend watering them less often but more deeply.
Before buying a used car, I suggest asking a mechanic to look at it first.
Our counsellors encourage students to visit the career centre during their first year.
For a first trip to Rome, I strongly recommend booking the museum tickets online.
Doctors suggest drinking plenty of water when you are recovering from a fever.
The coach encouraged the younger players to stay after practice and work on their passing.
If you enjoy slow-cooked stews, we would recommend trying the lamb with rosemary.
quiet: The staff were friendly and quick, and I stayed at this hotel twice while visiting the coast.
If your tomatoes keep splitting, the cause is usually uneven watering during hot weeks.
Before buying a used car, my brother asked a mechanic to look at it first.
Our counsellors met students at the career centre during their first year.
On my first trip to Rome, I booked the museum tickets online the night before.
Doctors noticed that patients drank plenty of water while recovering from a fever.
The coach watched the younger players stay after practice and work on their passing.
If you enjoy slow-cooked stews, the lamb with rosemary is on the menu on Fridays.

notes: Card: ' recommend' 12, ' suggest' 5, ' encourage' 2 of top 32, plus 'important to'. Output suppresses ' suggest'/' assume'.
